plan.summary: This 4-week block is a simple off-camp build for a beginner boxer with high sport load and only one 45-minute S&C slot each week. Week 1 establishes a useful baseline with a push-up strength assessment so future progress is easier to track, and the main training starts in Week 2. The block keeps power first, then full-body strength, then trunk and neck work in brief safe doses that do not interfere much with sparring.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general full-body strength and basic power with low-equipment work that stays recoverable around sparring.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Make the main bodyweight strength work harder and cleaner while keeping explosive intent high.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength, sharpen fast relaxed output, and stay fresh enough for boxing skill work.

exercises.name: Squat Jump
exercises.notes: Jump fast and land softly. Reset between reps and stop if height drops off.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if squat jumps feel awkward. Same fast takeoff and controlled landing.

substitutionOptions.name: Line Pogos
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this lower-impact option if jump tolerance is limited.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.notes: This session sets your baseline. Warm up with a few easy sets, then do one hard top set with strict form and stop when rep speed or position breaks.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then perform one all-out strict set of push-ups and log the total clean reps. This gives the app a baseline for future progression.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track your best strict set and aim to improve rep quality before chasing more reps.

substitutionOptions.name: Hands-Elevated Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if floor push-ups are too hard to perform cleanly.

substitutionOptions.name: Knee Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this only if you cannot keep good plank position on a standard push-up.

exercises.name: Split Squat
exercises.notes: Use a steady descent and drive up hard. Keep the front foot flat and the torso tall.

substitutionOptions.name: Reverse Lunge
substitutionOptions.notes: Good option if split squats bother your balance.

substitutionOptions.name: Bodyweight Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this easier option if single-leg work is too shaky right now.

exercises.name: Doorframe Row
exercises.notes: Lean back only as far as you can row cleanly. Keep ribs down and pull elbows toward your sides.

substitutionOptions.name: Table Inverted Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a stable table only if it is fully secure.

substitutionOptions.name: Towel Row Isometric
substitutionOptions.notes: Pull hard against a fixed anchor for 15-20 seconds if no safe row setup is available.

exercises.name: Hollow Body Hold
exercises.notes: Press the low back into the floor and breathe shallowly without losing position.

substitutionOptions.name: Dead Bug
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if you cannot keep the low back flat in the hollow hold.

exercises.name: Supine Neck Flexion
exercises.notes: Move slowly and keep it easy. This is light neck work, not a max effort.

substitutionOptions.name: Seated Towel Neck Flexion Isometric
substitutionOptions.notes: Press lightly into the towel for 10-15 seconds if dynamic reps feel awkward.

exercises.name: Squat Jump
exercises.notes: Each rep should be crisp and fast. Rest enough to keep jump quality high.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if it feels more natural while still staying explosive.

substitutionOptions.name: Line Pogos
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this lower-impact option if recovery is poor from sparring.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.notes: Leave 2 reps in reserve on every set. If standard push-ups are too hard, raise the hands and keep the same effort.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track your strongest clean set in the target range and build total quality reps across the block.

substitutionOptions.name: Hands-Elevated Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Best option if standard push-ups drop below the target rep range.

substitutionOptions.name: Tempo Knee Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a 3-second lower if you still need an easier variation.

exercises.name: Split Squat
exercises.notes: Control the bottom and stand up with intent. Keep balance clean rather than rushing reps.

substitutionOptions.name: Reverse Lunge
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if stepping back feels smoother than holding a split stance.

substitutionOptions.name: Bodyweight Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if single-leg work is still too unstable.

exercises.name: Doorframe Row
exercises.notes: Pause briefly at the top and lower under control. Keep the body stiff like a plank.

substitutionOptions.name: Table Inverted Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Only use a table if it is solid and safe.

substitutionOptions.name: Towel Row Isometric
substitutionOptions.notes: Pull hard for 15-20 seconds if you do not have a safe row setup.

exercises.name: V-Up
exercises.notes: Move smoothly and avoid yanking with the neck. Bend the knees slightly if needed.

substitutionOptions.name: Hollow Body Hold
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if full V-ups are too difficult to perform well.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.notes: Keep the body straight and the hips high. Stop before shaking turns the position sloppy.

exercises.name: Supine Neck Flexion
exercises.notes: Easy controlled reps only. Keep the jaw relaxed and do not strain.

substitutionOptions.name: Seated Towel Neck Flexion Isometric
substitutionOptions.notes: Press lightly for 10-15 seconds if you prefer a simpler option.

exercises.name: Squat Jump
exercises.notes: Stay springy and fast. If landings get noisy or slow, cut the set there.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if it helps you jump higher with cleaner rhythm.

substitutionOptions.name: Line Pogos
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this lower-impact option if the legs feel beat up from boxing.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.notes: Leave 1-2 reps in reserve. If all sets are easy and clean, make the body position stricter rather than rushing.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track the best strict set in the range and try to beat Week 2 with equal or better form.

substitutionOptions.name: Feet-Elevated Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this only if standard push-ups are already strong and stable.

substitutionOptions.name: Hands-Elevated Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if standard push-ups still fall short of the target range.

exercises.name: Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
exercises.notes: Use a small rear-foot elevation and stay balanced. Keep the front leg doing the work.

substitutionOptions.name: Split Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the elevated version is too unstable.

substitutionOptions.name: Reverse Lunge
substitutionOptions.notes: Good choice if the back-foot setup is inconvenient.

exercises.name: Doorframe Row
exercises.notes: Make the angle slightly harder only if you can keep full-body tension and clean reps.

substitutionOptions.name: Table Inverted Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a secure setup only.

substitutionOptions.name: Towel Row Isometric
substitutionOptions.notes: Pull hard for 20 seconds if no safe row setup is available.

exercises.name: V-Up
exercises.notes: Reach through the middle and keep the low back controlled on the way down.

substitutionOptions.name: Hollow Body Hold
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if V-ups lose shape.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.notes: Stay long from head to heel and keep the hips stacked.

exercises.name: Supine Neck Flexion
exercises.notes: Smooth easy reps only. Stop if the neck feels irritated.

substitutionOptions.name: Seated Towel Neck Flexion Isometric
substitutionOptions.notes: Light pressure for 10-15 seconds if you want a simpler option.

exercises.name: Squat Jump
exercises.notes: Keep every rep fast and clean. This is a lighter week, so finish feeling sharp.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if it feels smoother.

substitutionOptions.name: Line Pogos
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if you need the lowest-impact option.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.notes: Leave 2-3 reps in reserve. Smooth clean reps only this week.

performanceTarget.prompt: Use this week to hold technique and freshness, not to chase fatigue.

substitutionOptions.name: Hands-Elevated Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if you need an easier deload variation.

exercises.name: Split Squat
exercises.notes: Controlled reps with easy balance. Keep some spring in the legs for boxing.

substitutionOptions.name: Reverse Lunge
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if it feels more natural.

substitutionOptions.name: Bodyweight Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if you want the simplest deload option.

exercises.name: Doorframe Row
exercises.notes: Clean pulls and easy control on the way down. Do not grind reps this week.

substitutionOptions.name: Table Inverted Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use only if the setup is fully secure.

substitutionOptions.name: Towel Row Isometric
substitutionOptions.notes: Use 15-second holds if no safe row setup is available.

exercises.name: Hollow Body Hold
exercises.notes: Brace hard but keep it short and clean.

substitutionOptions.name: Dead Bug
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the hollow hold feels too demanding during the deload.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.notes: Short, solid holds with good alignment.

exercises.name: Supine Neck Flexion
exercises.notes: Very easy maintenance work only.

substitutionOptions.name: Seated Towel Neck Flexion Isometric
